csv_project_name: PM Service for Comprehensive Facilities Upgrade
csv_scope_of_work: Alvin College ( AC or College ) is seeking a sole proprietor or a single individual assigned by a firm to provide Staff Augmentation Project Management Services. The College is not seeking a full-service Program Management firm. Rather, the College is seeking a single individual to consult with the College and provide Staff Augmentation Project Management services on an as-needed basis, for projects as assigned, in connection with completed assessments contained in the College s Facilities Master Plan. The projects detailed are specific only to Buildings A, B, C and D on the main campus of Alvin College, located at 3110 Mustang Road, Alvin, TX 77511 Architectural Building Modifications and Improvements Mechanical Systems Upgrades Electrical Infrastructure Upgrades Plumbing Systems Upgrades Fire Protection System Upgrades Technology and Security Systems Upgrades.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

title: Project Management Service for Comprehensive Facilities Upgrade
short_description: Staff-augmentation project management for phased campus building upgrades at Alvin Community College.
project_location: Alvin Community College, 3110 Mustang Road, Alvin, TX 77511, Texas, USA
project_scope: Comprehensive facilities upgrade projects on the main campus focused on Buildings A, B, C, and D. Scope includes architectural building modifications and improvements, mechanical systems upgrades, electrical infrastructure upgrades, plumbing systems upgrades, fire protection system upgrades, and technology and security systems upgrades. The work is based on completed assessments in the College's Facilities Master Plan and is to be delivered on an as-needed basis.
services: Staff augmentation project management services by a sole proprietor or single individual assigned by a firm; consulting support for assigned projects related to the facilities master plan. The college explicitly states it is not seeking a full-service program management firm.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily a project management/staff augmentation procurement, which is explicitly low relevance for sbp.
- No structural engineering, bridge design, long-span roof, facade, or special structure scope is described.
- Building upgrades focus mainly on architectural, MEP, fire protection, and technology systems.
- Although the campus building program is sizable, the tender does not seek structural design or concept development services.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: total construction cost stated as $31.0M-$35.0M; midpoint used = 33,000,000 USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit design or engineering fee is stated. The procurement is for staff augmentation project management services rather than structural design services, so an sbp fee cannot be realistically derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Bidders must provide a sole proprietor or a single individual assigned by a firm for staff augmentation project management services. No specific reference counts or structural/technical qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
